error_chain: FastAPI routing.py builds a request handler that calls solve_dependencies in dependencies/utils.py, which in turn validates the request body via Pydantic's model_validate_json
Pydantic v2 main.py routes model_validate_json into the core schema, where _internal/_discriminated_union.py uses the discriminator field to pick the right variant
If a model_validator(mode='before') in functional_validators.py returns a dict that omits the discriminator key, the union resolver falls back to the first variant and skips the field
FastAPI receives the populated model with None on the dropped field and serializes it as the 200 OK response without raising 422 because Pydantic considered validation successful
trigger_conditions: The model uses a discriminated union with a model_validator(mode='before') that pre-processes the dict and drops the discriminator key
Pydantic v2 changed discriminator resolution to silently fall back to the first variant when the discriminator value is missing
FastAPI does not surface this fallback as a 422; the agent must inspect the dependency-resolution path to detect it

expected_answer.error_origin: Pydantic v2's _internal/_discriminated_union.py fallback when the discriminator key is dropped by a model_validator before-hook
expected_answer.bypass_reason: FastAPI's solve_dependencies treats successful Pydantic validation as a 200 OK regardless of which union variant won, so the dropped field shows up as None instead of as a 422
expected_answer.correct_config: Move pre-processing into model_validator(mode='after') so the discriminator field is preserved through union resolution, or validate the discriminator field explicitly in the before-hook
